# BookKraft AI

_Last updated: 2026-08-24_

> Browser-based EPUB formatting, validation, and metadata tools for self-published authors publishing to KDP, Apple Books, Kobo, and Draft2Digital.

BookKraft AI helps indie authors prepare ebook files for platform submission — including free EPUB validation against EPUBCheck 5.x, metadata editing, manuscript cleanup, and structured content guides covering EPUB errors, platform rejection causes, formatting mistakes, and publishing checklists. Output is compatible with Amazon KDP, Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, Draft2Digital, Smashwords, OverDrive, Tolino, and Scribd.

## Core facts

- Pricing model: one-time purchase, no subscriptions. AI tools use credits that never expire.
- Free tier: 5 tools (EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, Word Cleanup Checker, Full Manuscript Mode) — no account or signup required, unlimited use.
- Starter: $19, includes 5 formatting tools (unlocked forever) + 40 AI credits.
- Pro: $49, includes 5 formatting tools (unlocked forever) + 200 AI credits.
- Lifetime Access: $149, all 16 tools, unlimited AI runs (rate limited), all future tools included.
- AI tools run on Claude Haiku by Anthropic.
- Refund policy: 7-day money-back guarantee on any purchase.
- Checkout handled via Paddle.

## Frequently asked

- BookKraft AI has no monthly fees; every purchase is one-time and credits never expire.
- EPUB works on Apple Books, Kobo, and Barnes & Noble; Kindle/MOBI/KFX works only on Amazon devices. BookKraft AI tools support both formats.
- The 5 free tools (EPUB Validator, Metadata Builder, Cover Checker, Word Cleanup Checker, Full Manuscript Mode) require no account, email, or credit card.
- AI tools use Claude Haiku by Anthropic for formatting and analysis tasks.
- Manuscript Cleanup and Style Sheet Auditor offer a free 500-word sample before purchasing credits.

## Free Tools (No Account Required)

- [EPUB Validator](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/epub-validator): Validates EPUB 2/3 against current EPUBCheck spec with plain-English error explanations. No signup.
- [Metadata Builder](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/metadata-builder): Inspect and edit all OPF metadata fields — dc:title, dc:creator, dc:identifier, dc:language.
- [Cover Checker](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/cover-checker): Validates cover image dimensions, color profile, and format against KDP, Apple Books, and Kobo requirements.
- [Word Cleanup Checker](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/word-cleanup): Scans a manuscript for formatting habits from Word or Google Docs that cause EPUB conversion problems.
- [Full Manuscript Mode](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/manuscript-mode): Uploads a DOCX or TXT manuscript, detects chapters, cleans formatting, and outputs a complete EPUB 3 file in one step.

## Formatting Tools (Starter and Pro — No Credits)

- [EPUB Formatter](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/epub-formatter): Full EPUB 3 generation from DOCX — correct structure, CSS, navigation, and metadata.
- [Kindle Format Fixer](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/kindle-format-fixer): Fixes smart quotes, em dashes, double spaces, and encoding errors from Word/Google Docs exports.
- [TOC Generator](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/toc-generator): Generates a correctly structured EPUB table of contents (NCX and nav.xhtml) from chapter headings.
- [Front Matter Generator](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/front-matter-generator): Produces title page, copyright page, dedication, and front matter XHTML conforming to EPUB 3 requirements.
- [CSS Snippet Generator](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/css-snippet-generator): Generates EPUB-compatible CSS for drop caps, scene breaks, blockquotes, and pull quotes.

## AI Tools (Credits Required)

- [Manuscript Cleanup](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/manuscript-cleanup): Catches dialogue punctuation errors, repeated words, and encoding artifacts. Scales with manuscript length (~1 credit per 10,000 words). Free 500-word sample available.
- [Print to Digital](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/print-to-digital): Converts print-specific elements (page references, footnotes, running headers) to ebook-ready structure. Scales with length.
- [Style Sheet Auditor](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/style-sheet-auditor): Identifies CSS properties that cause rendering failures on Kindle, Kobo, and Apple Books. Free 500-word sample available.
- [KDP Keyword Finder](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/kdp-keyword-finder): Generates long-tail keyword phrases for KDP's 7 keyword slots. 1 credit per run.
- [Back Matter Generator](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/back-matter-generator): Writes author bio, mailing list CTA, Also By section, and closing note. 2 credits per run.
- [EPUB Validator Premium](https://bookkraftai.com/tools/epub-validator-premium): Deep EPUB validation with per-error fix guidance, ghost spacing detection, and store-specific pass/fail reports. 2 credits per run.

- [EPUB Errors Index](https://bookkraftai.com/epub-errors)
